title: VAPID SigningKey type derives no protective traits
description: push.rs:27 — AlertsConfig derives Debug and Clone, which is fine. But the real concern is that the VAPID SigningKey is handled as a raw String (PEM) throughout push.rs. At push.rs:58-78 (get_or_create_vapid_key), the private key PEM is returned as a bare String that could be accidentally logged or serialized. The function signature returns (String, String) where the first element is the private key PEM — there is no newtype wrapper to prevent accidental Display/Debug/Serialize. A Secret<String> wrapper (from the secrecy crate) or a custom newtype that redacts Debug output would prevent accidental exposure through logging or error messages.
